sloka: स्वस्त्यात्रेयो ऽथ भगवान्नमुचिः प्रमुचिस्तथा ।आजग्मुस्ते सहागस्त्या ये श्रिता दक्षिणां दिशम् ।। ७.१.३ ॥
transliteration: svastyātreyo 'tha bhagavānnamuciḥ pramucistathā ।ājagmuste sahāgastyā ye śritā dakṣiṇāṁ diśam ।। 7.1.3 ॥

translations.english: Svastyatreya, the revered Namuchi, and Pramuchi, along with Agastya, who resided in the southern direction, also came.
